source.title: Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis.

intervention.description: GlyR mRNA injected into the two dorsal blastomeres at 4-cell stage, embryos exposed to ivermectin from stage 17 to 23

readout.method: visual scoring of eye morphology in whole tadpoles

notes: Percent only, n not stated in text; normal = 100 minus reported malformed percent. Phenotypes included small, absent, incomplete eyes, fusion to brain, pigmented optic nerve.

source.title: Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis.
source.location: Results text (section on chloride modulation) and Fig. 2C

intervention.description: GlyR mRNA in two dorsal blastomeres, ivermectin and 60 mM choline chloride (isomolar chloride) in the medium during stage 17-23

readout.method: visual scoring of eye morphology in whole tadpoles

notes: Text gives 48% falling to 21% as external chloride rose to 60 mM; 0 mM arm duplicates Fig 2A arm; 20 mM value only in bar chart. n not stated (bar chart mean of 3 experiments).

source.title: Transmembrane voltage potential controls embryonic eye patterning in Xenopus laevis.

intervention.description: Dominant-negative Kir6.1 pore mutant mRNA injected into all four blastomeres at 4-cell stage

readout.method: visual scoring of eye morphology in whole tadpoles

notes: Text: 45% total eye-related phenotypes, about 25% endogenous eye defects and about 20% ectopic eye tissue (includes 7.5% complete ectopic eyes). Normal = 100 minus 45. Approximate values; n not stated. Ectopic category includes lens-only or pigment-only patches.
